name: PROJECT OVERLAW
detailed_description:
Inject power. Break the system.
Project Overlaw is a fast, brutal third-person looter shooter set in a fractured modern world. Inject Acid to awaken your combat potential, master high-mobility gunplay, and grind elite PvE missions to evolve your build, flex your style, and fight for survival.

BECOME ACID-BLOODED

You are an Overlaw — a modified fighter enhanced by the Acid system. Inject raw power into your body to unlock movement tech, passive augments, and lethal skills that redefine how you fight. From precise slides to kinetic double-jumps and combat vaults, every motion is a weapon.

LOOT, GRIND, EVOLVE

Every mission is high-risk, high-reward. Battle waves of AI enemies, elite squads, and world-tier threats in tight urban arenas. Earn randomized gear, upgrade builds with mods and stats, and chase your next perfect loadout. The deeper you go, the deadlier you get.

GUNPLAY BUILT FOR STYLE

Combat is fast, responsive, and mobility-first. Chain together bullet jumps, slides, mid-air aim glides, and weapon swaps to clear zones with brutal efficiency. Your loadout and your movement define your playstyle — master both.

CO-OP MISSIONS & FUTURE WAR

Team up or go solo in instanced PvE missions built for intensity and flow. Fight to unlock rare loot, flex your cosmetics, and push into harder challenges with evolving enemy types and world systems. PvP, trade, and events are on the horizon.

OWN YOUR LOOK

Customize your character from the bones up. Use layered gear to build your identity. Whether you lean streetwear, tactical, or total glitchcore — style is power.

CRIME. POWER. MONEY. RESPECT.
That’s the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
